summary: Add migration dry-run planner and apply primitives with checkpoint/rollback (MVP). DryRunPlanner produces phased MigrationPlan from inventory + .plate state. MigrationApplier supports dry-run and apply with simulated checkpoints. Real tests added to test_epic89_cutover.py. Delivers core of Issue #131 for template-to-plate cutover.
migration_guidance: New opt-in tooling. Existing users can continue using manual processes until full CLI surfaces (#132) land.
